# jumpcloud_notification_channel (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud notification channel by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by name
data "jumpcloud_notification_channel" "prod_webhook" {
  name = "Production Alerts"
}

# Look up by ID
data "jumpcloud_notification_channel" "by_id" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the notification channel. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the notification channel. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (String) JSON-encoded channel configuration.
- `description` (String) Description of the notification channel.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification channel is active.
- `type` (String) Channel type: CHANNEL_TYPE_EMAIL, CHANNEL_TYPE_SLACK, or CHANNEL_TYPE_WEBHOOK.
